title: AI World Gen
description: *AI World Gen* is a **map generator with two kinds of AI**. Describe a place, and a language model invents its vocabulary once; a fast **typed-decision model** (TypeSafe's Jev) then places every cell from its neighbours, live, one tile at a time.

Started at the [AI Hackathon Barcelona 2026](https://www.norrsken.org/houses/barcelona), I designed the split: the one creative job goes to a language model, the hundreds of repetitive decisions go to the model built for that. Bring your own **OpenRouter** key; the page has no server.
A flood fill catches sealed-off rooms, an inspector shows every cell's probabilities, and the logic is **covered by tests written before the code**.
